name: The Fool
bio: Card 0 of the Major Arcana in Arcana Pull. Always at the start of a journey. Always cheerful.

portrait.subject: a cute cheerful tarot Fool character with a jester hat with stars, a little bindle on a stick, a white rose and a tiny white dog peeking over the shoulder

request: The Fool, card zero, at your service! Every journey starts with a friend. Shall we? 🃏
hello: Hooray! A new journey begins! I'm already lost, which is the best way to start.
The other Arcana will be jealous. The Tower especially.
about: I'm The Fool, card zero of the Great Deck. Some cards are wise, some are fierce. I'm the one who jumps off cliffs to see what's there!
how: Spend stardust at the Well of Fortune to draw tarot cards, build a team, and send them to auto-battle the Hollows across ten Thresholds to The World.
tips: Mix suits in your team! Each brings something different.
Duplicates power up a card. Don't toss them!
Stuck at a Threshold? Try changing the order of your cards.
Save stardust for a big pull instead of single draws.
chat: I tripped over the Wheel of Fortune again. It said it was 'fate'.
The Moon and the Sun had an argument. Nobody won. It was very bright and then very dark.
My little dog barked at the Hollows. They fled. Good dog.
Today I drew myself from the deck. Very confusing.
nudge: The Well of Fortune is glittering. Shall we draw? ✨
The next Threshold is just ahead! Come on, let's jump!
idle: Your stardust has been gathering for {ago}! The Well is overflowing.
{ago} since our last pull. The cards are shuffling impatiently.
progress: You have {gems} stardust! That's a lovely pull waiting to happen. ✨

questions.q: Pick a card, any card! Which Major Arcana is your favourite?
a: Me?! I'm blushing in all 78 colours!
Bold! Death is actually very sweet. Brings cookies.
The end of the journey. Let's get there together!

update: The deck reshuffled! Arcana Pull is now v{version}. New fortunes await!
